messages.subject: Re: [MplusAutomation] Re: Request: extracting svalues and the list of loglikelihood values from output
messages.subject_clean: [MplusAutomation] Re: Request: extracting svalues and the list of loglikelihood values from output
messages.body_plain:
Hi Dina,

I'm not sure how @Michael would want to handle this kind of requests but, while there is no response from him, shall I recommend that you open an issue <https://github.com/michaelhallquist/MplusAutomation/issues/new> for your request?

I think that would be helpful to discuss the feature you are requesting and provide more precise info on it.  Also, it would be great if you could attach to the issue a sample output that could be used to test this feature.

I hope that helps.

Best,
Daniel

--
Daniel Morillo, Ph.D.
GitHub <https://github.com/DaniMori> |  ORCID <https://orcid.org/0000-0003-3021-3878>

El mar, 29 oct 2024 a las 21:41, Dina Arch (<dn...@ucsb.edu>) escribió:

> Hello,
>
> I wanted to kindly follow up on the feature request. It would be incredibly useful to have a way to extract error messages shown just before the "MODEL FIT INFORMATION" section, as well as those in TECH11 and TECH14 outputs. This addition would be very helpful for quickly identifying issues in the modeling process, as it is easy to overlook these during the automation of the models.
>
> Thank you again for your time.
> On Wednesday, October 23, 2024 at 9:56:51 AM UTC-7 Dina Arch wrote:
> >
> > Hello,
> >
> > I am writing to request a feature that would allow the extraction of svalues from the output for models that include OUTPUT: SVALUES, as well as the table of final stage loglikelihood values.
> >
> > Thank you very much for considering this request.
> >
> > Dina
>

messages.subject: Request: Help with Passing Mplus Output to create Diagrams
messages.subject_clean: Request: Help with Passing Mplus Output to create Diagrams
messages.body_plain:
Hello all,

Having some trouble reading in my mplus output in a way that is usable for R packages like ggplot or the like to create a SEM path diagram. Has anyone accomplished this before and provide guidance? Thank you!

messages.subject: Re: Request: Help with Passing Mplus Output to create Diagrams
messages.subject_clean: Request: Help with Passing Mplus Output to create Diagrams
messages.body_plain:
Use semPlot:

library(semPlot)
l <- "http://www.statmodel.com/usersguide/chap5/ex5.11.html"
download.file(l, modfile <- tempfile(fileext = ".out"))
Model <- semPlotModel(modfile)
semPaths(Model, rotation = 2)
